messages:
Morgan: Quick summary — GNAT-8B quant pilot results for GTN slices. Int8 vs Int4 across conversational + NLU slices. TL;DR: int4 ≈ 2.6–2.9x token cost reduction, avg quality drop ~1.4% absolute on our GTN score, p99 latency +25–35ms. Looking for product recs.
Sam: Numbers please.
Morgan: Key metrics (1M-sample replica): int8: cost_per_1k_tokens = $0.020; avg latency (1k context) = 140ms; GTN_PASS = 92.3%. int4: cost_per_1k_tokens = $0.0078; avg latency = 165ms; GTN_PASS = 90.9%.
Alex: Where is the regression concentrated? which slices?
Morgan: Mostly long-form summarization and entity extraction edgecases. Per-slice: recall drop on proper-noun extraction -3.2pp; hallucination rate up +0.8pp on multi-doc inputs.
Priya: Product: 1.4pp hit feels borderline. What's user-visible impact? any fail modes (safety or correctness) that break SLAs?
Sam: We ran human spot-checks on 200 examples: most diffs are stylistic or minor token omissions. Safety signals unchanged. A handful of hallucination increases but still below our alert threshold.
Morgan: Canary numbers from staging (24h, 10%): errors no change, p95 latency +10ms, p99 +28ms. Recommend: default routing int8 for high-precision routes (search, billing, docs-gen) and enable int4 for assist/low-risk flows with automatic fallback to int8 on low-confidence responses. Suggest 2-week A/B canary.
Priya: Cost math for GTN: if 60% of calls can be routed to int4, what's net unit savings?
Morgan: Rough calc: int4/int8 cost ratio ~0.39. If baseline all-int8 = $1.00 unit, shifting 60% to int4 => 0.6*0.39 + 0.4*1.0 ≈ 0.634 => ~36.6% saving on unit cost.
Alex: Any infra implications? KV cache hit rate, memory, tail behavior?
Sam: KV cache hits unchanged. Memory footprint fits same instance type. Tail latency worsens slightly because int4 kernel scheduling is noisier — might need to tune batch windows or autoscale thresholds.
Morgan: Eval command I used: ```bash
python eval/gtn_eval.py --model gnat-8b --quant int4 --slices gtn_core --samples 10000 --report out/int4_report.json
``` Output snippet: GTN_PASS: 90.9, BLEU: 28.7, RECALL_ENT: 65.1
Priya: Decision ask for GTN owners: proceed with staging canary or keep int8 default? My leaning: canary for low-risk surfaces with rollback and monitoring in place. :thinking_face:
Alex: I can wire the rollout flag + fallback. Will add watchers for GTN_PASS, hallucination_rate, p99 and an automated rollback if GTN_PASS drops >1.0pp or hallucination >+1.5pp.
Morgan: I'll assemble a concise scorecard with per-slice deltas and run a focused 50k sample on the regression slices (entity extraction, long multi-doc) and post results by EOD.
deploy-bot: canary flag gnat8b-quant-int4 enabled on staging at 10% traffic.
Sam: Noted. Keep a tight rollback window and thumbs on metrics.
Priya: :thumbsup: proceeding with canary + 2-week A/B. Thanks everyone.
